question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.

WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name as director_name,
        m.id as movie_id,
        CAST(m.date_published AS DATE) as pub_date,
        m.duration as movie_duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
),
director_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        director_name,
        pub_date,
        LAG(pub_date) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY pub_date) as prev_date,
        movie_duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        CASE WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(pub_date AS DATE) - CAST(prev_date AS DATE) ELSE NULL END as days_diff
    FROM director_movies
)
SELECT 
    name_id,
    director_name,
    movie_count,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_inter_duration AS INTEGER)) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    min_rating,
    max_rating,
    total_movie_duration
FROM (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        director_name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(movie_duration) as total_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        AVG(days_diff) as avg_inter_duration
    FROM director_with_lag
    GROUP BY name_id, director_name
)
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
